prompt:
Subject:
Bath time overlooking the sea

Main Figure:
One adult woman wrapped in a white bath towel at her chest, in an open-air bath facing the sea. A near full-body hot spring portrait sitting sideways in the water and looking back at the camera over her shoulder from the center of the screen.

Person/Expression:
Rounded oval face and small chin, large dark brown almond-shaped eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, light coral lips. Facing the camera over her own left shoulder, directing her gaze forward, smiling softly without showing teeth. Dark brown hair tied in a loose bun high on the back of the head, with thin bangs and long strands hanging from the front of the ears to the neck. Light eye makeup and pink blush, natural skin moistened by steam.

Clothing/Pose:
No clothes or swimwear shown, a white pile bath towel wrapped diagonally from the chest to the waist to cover the front of the body. Sitting sideways in the water with both knees bent to the person's own left. Back toward the camera, looking back only with the upper body, both arms bent in front of the chest to hold the towel.

Background/Light:
Shallow stone-lined open-air bath, transparent light brown water and the person's reflection on the water surface. A thick light yellow bamboo pillar on the left, a thin metal railing behind. Beyond the railing is a quiet blue-gray sea, a row of wave-dissipating blocks, green mountains stretching from the left to the back, and a light blue cloudy sky. Soft diffused light from the sky as the main light, with warm reflected light from the bamboo on the left and the water surface, uniformly illuminating the shoulders and face.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. A wide portrait taken from a camera slightly higher than the water surface, with a very light high-angle shot. The person is placed largely in the center-left, capturing from the head to the tips of the bent legs underwater. The horizon is in the upper half, the water surface in the lower half, framed by the bamboo pillar on the left edge and the railing on the right. Focus on the face and back, with the mountains slightly blurred with medium depth of field.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic live-action photograph. Naturally depicts wet skin, the white towel, transparent water, surface reflections, bamboo, stone, and the distant sea. A quiet and clean hot spring travel atmosphere centered on pale blue-gray and bamboo ocher.

Negative:
Do not use an indoor bath or a background with only mountains; do not remove the towel or face the front.
